profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer, Data & AI at Intuit
profile.summary:
● Actively looking for full time opportunity in Software Development
● Graduate Software Engineering Student at San Jose State University with Specialization in Enterprise Software Technologies and Cloud Computing, Having 2+ years of Software Development experience 
● Passionate about Big Data and Distributed systems technologies
● Worked as a Data Engineering Intern at Intuit Inc., Mountain View.
● Working on Real TIme Data capture and Processing pipeline as a part of Intuit's Data Infrastructure 

● Currently :  ✔  Software engineer, Big Data at Intuit Inc, Mountain View 
	             
● Worked as a "Software Engineering Intern" at Tintri Inc., Mountain View.

● Experience of developing end to end Real Time Data Processing pipeline,  Good knowledge of machine learning algorithms, ETL cycle implementations, Database Design and concepts
● Experience of working on Web Development with JAVA and MEAN  Stack 
● Worked with Agile Software Development Methodology

TECHNICAL SKILLS 

Languages	 : -	JAVA, NodeJS, Python,  JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Jquery, AngularJS, Express, C, JAX-RS
Databases : - MongoDB,  MySQL, Oracle, AWS S3, AWS RedShift, AWS RDS, SAP HANA basics
Cloud Technologies : -  Amazon AWS, IBM Bluemix, IBM Cloudant, Pivotal 
Big Data Processing Framework	: -	Kafka, apache Spark, Hadoop
Web Development Framework 	:- 	JAVA Spring MVC, MEAN Stack,  Python Django, Python Flask, RESTful Web Services
Business Intelligence Tools	  :-  	SAP Business Intelligence, Informatica, Business Object
IDE 				                   :- 	Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA, NetBeans
Version Control		           :-  	Git, Mercurial, SVN 
Project Management                  :-  JIRA

Area of Interest
● Big Data and Distributed Systems
● Data Analytics and Data Mining
● Cloud Computing and Virtualizations
● Web development


GitHub URL: - https://github.com/BharatRPatel/Projects.git

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading Intuit's Customer Data Cloud (C360): a platform processing 8B+ events/day into unified customer profiles powering Intuit Products like TurboTax, QuickBooks, and AI-driven experiences.
 
- Own large-scale data platforms serving unified customer data, designed for scale, privacy, and reliability.
- Make enterprise data AI-ready, enabling consumption by AI agents and natural language interfaces in production.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and built real-time data platforms at Intuit, unifying data from dozens of enterprise sources into 360° customer profiles.
 
- Built streaming data pipelines and processing frameworks powering large-scale data unification
- Developed data storage and serving layers with real-time change propagation, enabling marketing and personalization use cases

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
•	Involved in development of Real time Data Streaming Platform using Kafka to collect clickstream events and store it into AWS S3 Data Lake and Intuit HDFS.
•	Designed and Implemented Admin layer with Java Rest API using Play framework for streaming data pipeline which provides functionality of creating and updating topic configuration in Kafka cluster.
•	Developed Real-time data transformation and processing capability using Java, Spark, Spark Streaming and AWS S3.
•	Automated the infrastructure deployment of data collection pipeline with Terraform, AWS Cloud formation and Jenkins pipeline.
•	Implemented dynamic property management for zero downtime config changes and customer onboardings in data pipeline using Archaius.
•	Implemented the encryption, logging, monitoring and alerting capabilities in data pipelines with Splunk, AppDynamics, wavefront and cloud watch alarms.

positions.title: Data Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Real Time Data Capture, Processing and Reporting Pipeline 

Technologies :- Apache Spark, Apache Spark Streaming, JAVA, Apache Kafka, log4j, Tableau Visualization, AWS S3, AWS RedShift, Vertica

●	Developed Real time data capture pipeline using Apache Kafka to collect the click stream data and transactions from various Intuit Products.
●	Real time data stream data processing capability using Apache Spark and Spark Streaming.
●	Developed staging layer using AWS S3 to store data processed by Spark Streaming.
●	Utilized AWS RedShift Cluster to store aggregated data for reporting purpose.
●	Utilized Tableau for generating real time reports.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant for Big Data and Web Mining
positions.description:
•	Work with Professor  on explaining the concepts of Data Mining, Recommendation Systems and Machine Learning algorithms to students. 
• Hands-on development using Apache Spark MLib, Mahout machine learning libraries and tools.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Technologies :- Python Django, JAVA, Elastic-Search, HTML, CSS , JavaScript, JQuery, MySQL , Salesforce CRM, AWS S3, AWS RDS

● Worked on Tintri's Analytics Platform which includes fetching Data from Customer's Virtual Machines (VMs) for performance monitoring, parsing data through JAVA parser and storing it in Elastic-Search for building dashboards out of that data. 
● Developed Tintri's Support Portal using Python Django Web Framework, MySQL database, Salesforce CRM, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and JQuery.

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
Database Design and web application development . 

Technologies :- MongoDB, JAVA

Help Masters student in their thesis project for Database Design and web application development work.

positions.title: Software Developer - Assistant System Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies: - Java, JSP, Servlet, SPRING MVC framework, JavaScript, AJAX, Oracle 
Database Technologies: - Oracle, MySQL
Business Intelligence Technologies: - SAP BI, Informatica 

Responsibilities :- 

• Developed and Maintained JAVA Web applications for Taxation Domain which includes modules such as Registration, Payment, Audit, Refund etc.
• Implemented User Interface and Client Side Validations using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Jquery.
• Built and maintained Business Intelligence system for retail store on its data warehouse.
• Maintained ETL cycle: Performed Data Extraction from transnational system to analytics system,  Data cleansing, transformation and Data loading into Info Providers for report generation.
• Used tortoise SVN for version control.
• Designed data models such as star schema for Dashboard generation.
• Mentored team of four people and help them understand existing project and client requirements.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Technologies: - JAVA, JSP, Servlet, HTML, JavaScript
Database Technologies: - MySQL

Responsibilities :-
•	Develop and maintain “Electronic Medical Record” software on JAVA, HTML, AJAX, JavaScript and MySQL platforms.
Modules :- appointment management and scheduler module, billing module and document manger module. 

• Analyze the reporting application to improve performance and runtime of reports.

projects.title: Yahoo Hackathon ! Performance Monitoring and Automated Healing in Distributed Systems (3rd Rank)
projects.description:
Technologies Used :- JAVA, MongoDB, HTML, CSS, JavaScript

• Secured 3rd Rank in Yahoo Hackathon for providing efficient solution.
• Design and Implemented the solution for Performance Monitoring in Distributed Systems and provide Automated Resolution for Issues.
• JAVA is used to process server logs and trigger Automated Solutions.
• MongoDB is used for Storing server logs for the purpose of solving server issues and performing analytics on Server Logs.

projects.title: Project Planner : A MultiTenant SaaS Application
projects.description:
Technology 'stack :- NodeJS,  MongoDB, Java'script, MySQL, MongoDB, HTML, CSS

● Developed a SaaS application which provides project management capabilities in three methodology Waterfall, Scrum and Kanban.
● Database is designed using the "MultiiTenancy principal of SaaS application" so that scalability is ensured.
